scope: all 808 canonical Phase-21 VAL probability maps

finding.summary: the persisted float16 probability map cannot determine the persisted uint8 prediction; exact-0.5 pixels are labelled BOTH ways in the stored data
finding.root_cause: the canonical pass thresholded float32 sigmoid outputs and then persisted the probabilities as float16; the two sides of the boundary collapse onto the same stored value

ge_float32_prob_ge_0p5.note: torch.sigmoid(y).ge(0.5) is the frozen Phase-20/21 rule

rationale: it is the rule the frozen evaluation code actually uses
it leaves the smaller residual of the two candidates
it is applied IDENTICALLY to the canonical reference maps and to every Phase-22 diagnostic probe, so all comparisons are internally consistent
decision.residual_effect_on_reported_dice: below 1e-4 at native resolution (measured on the 40-sample smoke run: 0.8661295 canonical-rule vs 0.8653136 stored-pred)
forbidden_claims: that the persisted pred array is exactly reproducible from disk
that Phase-21 Dice can be recovered to arbitrary precision from the persisted probability maps
